trends.trendName: Guaranteed lifetime renewal, no claims loading
trends.whatProductOffers: Guarantees renewal every year for life and states the renewal premium will not be raised because of claims made or changes in health; a no-claim bonus refunds 5%, 10% or 15% of the preceding cover year's premiums after 3, 4 or 5+ claim-free years.

keyFigures.label: Guaranteed renewal
keyFigures.condition: Not affected by claims or health changes

keyFigures.label: Premium loading
keyFigures.value: None for claims or health changes
keyFigures.condition: Renewal premium still follows prevailing rates

keyFigures.label: Bonus basis
keyFigures.value: Total premiums paid for the preceding cover year

exclusionsOrConditions: Renewal premium is based on the prevailing premium rates at renewal, so it can still change with age and medical inflation.
The no-claim bonus is a refund of a percentage of premiums, not a discount on the renewal rate.
Specified outpatient surgery at network clinics or a top-up subsidy claim does not affect bonus eligibility.
